CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_invoice_totals(target_invoice_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.invoices i
  set subtotal = coalesce((
        select sum(ii.line_total)
        from public.invoice_items ii
        where ii.invoice_id = target_invoice_id
      ), 0)
  where i.id = target_invoice_id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_receipt_totals(target_receipt_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  update public.receipts r
  set subtotal = coalesce((
        select sum(ri.line_total)
        from public.receipt_items ri
        where ri.receipt_id = target_receipt_id
      ), 0)
  where r.id = target_receipt_id;
end;
$function$
